digest.component_or_area: CLI bridge noun and subcommand group
propositions: The bridge noun must establish safe, working vertical slice with preview and sync verbs only, leaving all legacy top-level commands (reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck, doctor) fully functional
Preview verb performs read-only dry-run with no Jira or ticket-store mutation; sync verb performs live mutations
No placeholder or unimplemented verb is advertised; downstream stories add setup, check-access, fsck, status, pause, resume only when functional
Callers cannot pass --mode or --filter-local-ids through bridge preview/sync to override read/write distinction
Mode.py, MODE_CAPS, and gated_mode reconcile-check round trip must survive unchanged for MCP surface and phase-gate compatibility
User guide, CLI reference, and release notes document only the staged surface (preview, sync) that actually ships, with all legacy commands explicitly preserved
